name: kktestdev-pack
description: Team onboarding pack: /kk-onboard inventories what you already have installed or connected, skips what is already there, audits existing skills/MCP/plugins/hooks for redundancy and risk, and asks you item by item (neutral pros and cons) what to install, keep, or remove. /kk-update pulls the latest of everything the pack manages. Installs nothing by itself.
